T2 - Documents Endpoints
/api/partner/1.0/t2/documents/getList (POST)
Endpoint authentication
When adopting OAuth 2.0 as an authentication method, the below security requirements are needed in order to trigger this endpoint:
The user must fulfill the below security roles requirements; if he fails to obtain access to all the necessary security roles, an
error 403: Insufficient privileges to execute this request
is returned:
The user must acquire access to the following security role:
Tax â Access T2 Product
When the user has access to the below security role, he is able to use the property
customReturnManagerFilterIds
in the request body to filter the results based on the custom filter Id(s) provided. In case the user does not have access to the said security role and he tries to apply a filter, an error 403:
Insufficient privileges to execute this request
is returned:
Tax â Return Manager â Custom Filters - Apply
This endpoint validates against the userâs contact security and document visibility. If the user does not have access to a given document or to the contact associated to this document, the document will not be included in the response body.
Endpoint description
Returns a list of documents with all metadata available in the return manager for a specific year of the T2 product.
Note:
Requesting the list of documents for the latest taxation period displayed in the return manager will return the list of documents for all years supported by this version. For example, if the last year currently displayed in the return manager supports 2022 and later, this means that getting the list of documents for 2023 will return the list of documents present in the return manager for the 2022 and later period.

perPage:
Optional parameter that controls the number of results per page (1-500). If you do not include the per page parameter, the application will default to 500.

Optional parameter used for filtering out results based on column(s) value(s). One or more columnIDs must be provided with values to use. The list of columnIDs is available

Optional parameter used to include or exclude planner files. If you do not include the excludePlanner parameter, the application will include the planner documents by default.

/api/partner/1.0/t2/documents (POST)
Endpoint authentication
When adopting OAuth 2.0 as an authentication method, the below security requirements are needed in order to trigger this endpoint:
The user must fulfill the below security roles requirements; if he fails to obtain access to all the necessary security roles, an error 403: Insufficient privileges to execute this request is returned:
The user must acquire access to the following security roles:
Tax â Access T2 Product
Tax â Returns - Add
The user cannot create a document for a new contact if he does not have access to the below security role:
Contacts - View, Add and Edit Contacts
This endpoint validates against the userâs
contact security
. If the user does not have access to the contact associated to the document he is requesting to create, an
error 400: Resource not found in the system
is returned.
Endpoint description
Creates a new T2 document and once created, returns the metadata of the new document including its ID. This endpoint can manage to create a document from both an existing contact or for a new contact.
Creating a T2 document from an existing contact.

}

Taxation year-start date of the document.
taxYearEndDate:
Taxation year-end date of the document.
details:
Details to add to the document (optional).
labelId:
The value of the label to be associated to the document (optional).
existingClientCode:
Client Code of the existing contact for which you want to create a document.
